summary: A slide re-authored by a later operation attempt receives the reason the earlier attempt rejected it as its correction hint, on both the batch and single-slide authoring paths.
invariants: The hint is derived only from the slide's own durable checkpoint record, never from another slide or another job.
Generic wrapper messages carry no instruction and are dropped; the hint is bounded to 400 characters of cause text.
A checkpoint with no recorded reason yields no hint and the attempt starts clean.
Carrying a hint never changes the provider ordinal a batch reserves: recovery status still decides that.
forbidden: Re-send the identical prompt to a slide a previous attempt already rejected when the reason is recorded.
Let a correction hint widen a slide's provider call budget.
rationale: Operation ce48036c failed both of slide 35's provider calls on the same header contract violation; an attempt that repeats the prompt reproduces the rejection.
The in-slide retry loop already sends a correction after a local failure, so the machinery existed and only the durable seam across operation attempts was missing.
Pairs with authored.provider-attempt-budget-per-operation-attempt: the budget change lets the retry call the provider, and this change tells it what to fix.
